--auto-approve-tools.help: Allow agent tools to run without prompting

--dimensions.help: Truncate output embeddings to specified dimension (embedding models only)

--draft-quantize.help: Quantize draft model to this level

--experimental-websearch.help: Enable web search tool in experimental mode

--experimental-yolo.help: Skip all tool approval prompts (use with caution)

--fused-qkv.help: Enable fused QKV projection for faster attention

--gpu-capture.help: Capture GPU trace to .gputrace file (run with MTL_CAPTURE_ENABLED=1)

--image.help: Filename for an image to include

--imagegen.help: Use the imagegen runner for LLM inference

--keepalive.help: Duration to keep a model loaded (e.g. 5m)

--negative-prompt.help: Negative prompt for CFG (empty = no CFG, matching Python)

--nowordwrap.help: Don't wrap words to the next line automatically

--output.help: Output file for results (stdout if empty)

--prompt-tokens.help: Generate prompt targeting ~N tokens (0 = use -p prompt)

--quantize.help: Quantize model to this level (e.g. q4_K_M)

--restore.help: Restore an integration to its default profile

--system.help: Show system message of a model

--think.help: Enable thinking mode: true/false or high/medium/low for supported models

--truncate.help: For embedding models: truncate inputs exceeding context length (default: true). Set --truncate=false to error instead

--warmup.help: Number of warmup requests before timing

--wired-limit.help: Metal wired memory limit in GB

--yes.help: Automatically answer yes to confirmation prompts

launch.help: Launch the Ollama menu or an integration

pull.help: Pull a model from a registry

push.help: Push a model to a registry
